Use with caution / monitor

Coadministration of clopidogrel and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), a category to which aspirin belongs, increases the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding [clopidogrel:drug_interactions:3, aspirin:warnings:0]. Aspirin itself can cause severe stomach bleeding, and the risk is higher when taken with other blood-thinning or NSAID drugs [aspirin:warnings:0].
